paraphrase: CCC 185-197: whoever says 'I believe' says 'I adhere to what we believe'; communion in faith needs a common language of faith that is a norm for all; the creeds are called professions of faith because they summarize the faith Christians profess; at baptism we receive the creed, and to recite the 'Credo' in faith is to enter into communion with the Father, Son and Holy Spirit and with the whole Church.
